== Compact object headers

[.track]
Intro · Problem · [.on]#Definitions# · Solutions · AI skills · Wrap-up

[.lead]
The object header shrinks from 12 bytes to 8-bytes (JEP 519, JDK 25).

image::diagram-04-object-headers.svg[HashMap$Node 32 B vs 24 B,role=diagram]

* Off by default: `-XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders`.
* An object only shrinks if it then fits a smaller 8-byte boundary.
